== Callandor? ==

In EOTW, when the party found the Eye, and then Rand used up the saidin contained therein, only three objects were found at the bottom of the emptied pool: The Dragon Banner, the Horn of Valere, and one of the seven seals to the Dark One's Prison. Callandor was (as we all know) located in the Stone of Tear at that time awaiting the Dragon Reborn to claim it. Additionally, in TSR, chapter 26 (pages 428-431, Kindle edition) as Deindre and a group of female Aes Sedai prepare Someshta for his trip to the location of the Eye, though a crystal sword is present (and it is very likely that it is Callandor), one of the Aes Sedai say "the sword must wait." There is actually no mention of the Horn, only of the Dragon Banner. And there is no mention at all of what will be sent with Someshta, for that matter, only that they have a task for him. Finally, in TWORJWOT, when discussing Callandor, it specifically states that it was placed in the Stone sometime during the Breaking to keep it away from mad male Aes Sedai. How could it get from the Eye (Someshta's location) to Tear if it were at the bottom of a pool of liquid Saidin?

In the end we don't know what was sent with Someshta when the Aes Sedai sent him to guard the Eye. We can only guess. But my money is on one item being absent, and that is Callandor. That's why I have placed the verify tag next to it in the list of items given to Someshta. As this intrigues me, I will continue to research it to figure it out one way or the other. I invite other points of view. [[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 00:34, June 22, 2012 (UTC)

I agree, Callandor was not among the items given to Someshta. It was present in the Hall of Servants at the same time as Someshta was given his task, but only because this was the staging grounds for all of the Aes Sedai's last ditch efforts to preserve what they could for the future. The Aiel were also present there, given their task of guarding objects of the power, but had nothing to do with Someshta or the Eye of the World.
